digest.component_or_area: DC sub-task parent sync / outbound field diffing
propositions: A non-epic parent on a sub-task is suppressed at emit-time with no durable signal, making hierarchy divergence invisible to operators
DC silently ignores fields.parent writes on sub-tasks (req-0056/0058) and returns 400 on nulling attempts, making sub-task reparenting unrepresentable
Two harness cells that asserted sub-task parent round-trips were wrong oracles testing an operation the platform cannot perform and were re-homed to Epic Link equivalents
The supported mechanism for parent syncing on DC is the Epic Link custom field on non-sub-task children, which passes both inbound and outbound round-trip tests
The emit-side suppression of non-epic parents must produce a durable bridge alert naming the reason and supported alternative, not exit silently reporting convergence
